data.title: Feed a Student for a Semester
data.summary: Many needy students skip meals to stay in school. KES 3,000 gives one student daily meals for three months, so they can focus on their studies.
body: Our target is to feed 30 students this semester. Meal vouchers are bought from restaurants at the university and given out through the Imam's office, with AEDT selecting the students and overseeing distribution.
Give for one student, or for several. Every KES 3,000 is another student who can eat and learn.
asks: Give any amount: it all adds up

data.title: Help Her Start Her Studies
data.summary: A bright student has a place at university but cannot afford to start. Together we can raise KES 70,000 to get her into class.
body: The money goes into a revolving study fund. It pays her fees as she studies, and as it is repaid it is used again, semester after semester, until she completes.
When she graduates, the same money keeps going: it moves on to support the next student. One contribution, many futures.
asks: Share this campaign with friends and family
Ask your workplace to match your gift

data.title: Together, We Can Do More
data.summary: We were once supported. Now it's our turn to give back. Join fellow AEDT beneficiaries and graduates to connect, empower one another and open doors for the next student.
body: Africa Education and Development Trust has been a bridge to opportunity for thousands of students. Behind every number is a story: a dream pursued, a challenge overcome and a future made possible through education.

This campaign invites every beneficiary and graduate to keep that story going, through mentorship, skills development, volunteering, job linkages, and support for bright but financially disadvantaged students.
asks: Register as a member for KES 500
Choose a monthly contribution you can keep up
Mentor, volunteer or share an opportunity

data.title: A New Chapter Begins
data.summary: The online unveiling of the AEDT Beneficiaries Association and its new digital home, ahead of the formal launch planned for January.
body: With this unveiling, the Association is open to its community: current beneficiaries, graduates and everyone who believes in the mission.
asks: Watch and share the launch film

data.title: Keep a Student in Class
data.summary: Member contributions pay school fees for needy students, including orphans, and help university students facing financial difficulties get meals and other essentials.
body: Giving back is not just about what we have. It is about what we are willing to share. Every contribution, large or small, goes towards keeping a student learning.
asks: Give a one-off gift by M-Pesa
Tell us about a student in need
